market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver would need a >3x rally from current levels (~$32) in ~15 months, far exceeding its all-time high of ~$50. Such an unprecedented move is extremely unlikely under normal economic conditions, making the market's 6.7% implied probability too optimistic.
evidence_points: Silver futures have never traded near $120; all-time high is ~$49.80 in 2011.
Current macroeconomic outlook and industrial demand do not justify a tripling in that timeframe.
The resolution source (CME settlement) reflects official settlement prices, which would need to exceed this extreme level on any trading day before July 2026.
